classifications.evidence: The controller stopped solely when 2.628 mm longitudinal and 0.0016 mm lateral residuals entered the 3 mm box; it has no fine-step stage. Linear extrapolation of one more 3 mm step crosses the target by about 0.34 mm but would likely be closer; it was not executed.

Calibration and navigation use UNITY_WORLD_IDENTITY, the frozen target is copied unchanged, final quaternion exactly matches, and actor/evaluator errors agree. Exact calibration publication metadata was not persisted, so this is refuted at the recorded pose-contract level rather than by a complete calibration provenance record.
Hashes, dimensions, capture function and recomputation agree; SSIM recomputes exactly. A natural same-pose calibration repeat scores 0.989491 above the locked 0.971 threshold.

At identical orientation, the 2.660 mm contact residual yields SSIM 0.643609 and visibly different interfaces; evaluator-only same-pose-vs-return beam intersections also change. No direct intermediate P1 images exist, so the exact sensitivity curve is unresolved.

Static audit finds no query-position use in image-only selection and no hidden coordinate in fusion after perturbation. The offline protocol is optimistic because paths and 3 mm grids nearly coincide, but it was not in the physical control loop and did not cause this failure.

notClaimed: The audit does not prove a particular sub-millimetre SSIM operating point because no P1 intermediate frames were captured.
primaryAttribution: Premature coarse-tolerance STOP combined with real ultrasound sensitivity to the residual scan-plane translation.
